findings.title: Fronted destination reverses attempted escape

findings.mechanism: The exact HFT outlier binds focus root_000065/B003 to attributed occurrences for working at 88:3, following-track imagery at 88:5, purposeful striving at 88:9, and continuous flow at 88:12. Their distinct motions meet the focus return as one kinetic process image.
findings.reader_payoff: The reader can feel return as accumulated movement, not only as a final instant, while the watering, striving, flowing, and return images remain distinct.
findings.containment: This is form-distant and exploratory, especially at the non-dominant س ق ي mapping. It is a kinetic process image, not a claim that the context roots and إياب are synonyms.

epistemic.reason: The exact outlier trace has complete anchors but exploratory confidence and legacy-unbound identity; its cross-domain synthesis is explicitly bounded.

findings.title: Concealment cannot secure an outside
findings.claim: The focus return can become the point at which chosen concealment is gathered into an all-reaching event and can no longer secure an exterior refuge.
findings.mechanism: The exact HFT outlier binds the focus gathering point to an attributed encompassing event and manifestation at 88:1 and to concealment of truth at 88:23. The return point is where the covering movement is gathered into the event's reach.
findings.reader_payoff: The focus's short return statement acquires a concrete boundary effect: concealment may be attempted, but the person remains within the event that reaches all.
findings.containment: Both the encompassing event and disbelief can activate covering images, so the reversal remains an exploratory abductive model. The focus noun is not defined as disclosure.

epistemic.reason: The exact outlier trace has complete anchors but exploratory confidence and legacy-unbound identity; the concealment-versus-manifestation relation is explicitly bounded.
